versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "coding-disciplines", an evolving set of AI coding discipline rules with mechanisms to record and prevent repeated coding mistakes.
- Introduces core rules (R1–R12) covering error prevention, safe workflows, annotation standards, batch execution, and enforced project documentation.
- Features a "progressive evolution zone" that accumulates encountered error patterns and incorporates them into active defense strategies for future coding tasks.
- Enforces mandatory project files (`framework.md` & `WORK_LOG.md`) and structured worklog updates as blocking requirements before and during coding.
- Integrates with stepwise task breakdowns, automatic progress board synchronization, and rigorous workflow gates for quality assurance.
- Provides a checklist of common error patterns and details a systematic self-evolution mechanism for continuous improvement.
